items.text: Populate a fresh disk cache via production sync. Offline after relaunch, read tasks, transcript, pending decisions, attachment metadata and the saved cursor. `cmd:scripts/swift-test`

Interrupt a save and restart. The durable cursor never leads the stored data. Replay from the last committed cursor restores each change once. Repeated foreground transitions, dropped connections and host-log replacement preserve isolation between hosts. `cmd:scripts/swift-test`
A phone task streams into the list, survives relaunch and remains available for a follow-up. `cmd:scripts/demo/durable-list.sh`, `cmd:scripts/demo/followup.sh`
